title: Refuse $1,000,000 And Win One Real Wish
description: Four strangers on a floating island, a wizard's kettle full of cash, and one wish that can never be for yourself. Would you take the money or wait? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Wizard Orin: ancient man, very long silver beard and long silver hair, kind deep-set eyes, floor-length deep green wool robe with a brown rope belt, bare feet, no hat
characters.Ume: 72-year-old Japanese grandmother, gray hair in a neat bun, round face, brown knit cardigan over a lavender blouse, dark gray long skirt, no hat, no glasses
characters.Leo: 19-year-old American college guy, curly red hair, freckles, mustard yellow hoodie, blue jeans, white sneakers, no hat
characters.Dara: 35-year-old Brazilian woman, long black hair in a high ponytail, blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt, black trousers, no hat
characters.Bao: 11-year-old Vietnamese boy, black bowl-cut hair, green and white striped t-shirt, brown shorts, red sneakers, no hat

scenes.say: Four strangers, one floating island, one real wish. Whoever turns down the most money gets it. And the wizard running this has been granting wishes for 300 years.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Wide 90s anime film shot: one small grassy floating island drifting above a sea of clouds at dawn, an old stone teahouse on it. [4-7s] Inside the stone teahouse on the floating island, Leo and Dara sit at a low wooden table, staring out the round window in shock. [7-10s] Inside the same teahouse, Ume and Bao sit across the table while Wizard Orin pours tea from an old iron kettle, his silver beard catching the light.

scenes.say: Every hour, his iron kettle pours out a briefcase of cash. Take it, and a cloud carries you gently home. But one rule: the wish can never be for yourself.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the stone teahouse, Wizard Orin tips the iron kettle and a plain black briefcase slides out of the spout onto the low table. [4-7s] Close-up of one small white cloud floating just outside the teahouse doorway, waiting. [7-10s] Close-up of Wizard Orin raising one finger inside the teahouse, eyes serious, candlelight on his face.

scenes.say: Hour one: $100,000. Leo grabs it, laughing, and drifts away on his cloud. Hour two: $500,000. Dara holds out until her hands shake, then takes it too.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Leo hugs the black briefcase and steps onto the small white cloud at the teahouse doorway, laughing. [4-7s] Leo sinks past the grassy edge of the floating island into the sea of clouds, waving. [7-10s] Inside the teahouse, close-up of Dara's trembling hands hovering over a second black briefcase on the low table.

scenes.say: Now it's just Ume, seventy-two, and Bao, eleven. Hour three: $1,000,000. Bao stares at it. 'My mom works two jobs,' he whispers. Ume squeezes his hand and nods.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the stone teahouse, Ume and Bao sit alone at the low table, two empty cushions beside them. [4-7s] Close-up of Bao staring at a black briefcase on the table, his face reflected in its shiny clasp. [7-10s] Close-up of Ume gently squeezing Bao's small hand and nodding.

scenes.say: So Bao takes the million and floats home. Ume wins the one real wish. But it can't be for herself, so she turns to the wizard. 'What would you wish for?'
scenes.video: [0-4s] Bao waves from his small white cloud, clutching the briefcase, drifting away from the floating island at sunset. [4-7s] Inside the stone teahouse, Ume sits alone across the low table from Wizard Orin. [7-10s] Close-up of Wizard Orin's eyes going wide, the iron kettle trembling in his hands.

scenes.say: Nobody had asked him that in 300 years. So Ume wished him one quiet garden to grow old in. Four strangers came for a real wish. The wizard got it.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up inside the teahouse: one tear rolls down into Wizard Orin's silver beard. [4-7s] Wizard Orin kneels in a small vegetable garden behind a wooden farmhouse on the ground, planting seeds, sunlight on his face. [7-10s] Ume and Wizard Orin sip tea together on the farmhouse porch at sunset, the empty floating island drifting away in the sky behind them.
